description: This file implements functions for converting IPv4 and IPv6 addresses from binary to presentation (string) format, including inet_ntop4 and inet_ntop6, and a wrapper inet_ntop. It handles address formatting, supports IPv6 shorthand notation, and references system headers and utility functions.

methods.name: inet_ntop4
methods.description: Formats an IPv4 address from binary to dotted decimal string.

methods.name: inet_ntop6
methods.description: Formats an IPv6 address from binary to compressed string with shorthand notation.

methods.name: inet_ntop
methods.description: Converts a network address (IPv4 or IPv6) to presentation format, calling the appropriate function based on address family.
